benchmarks.text: 43% of external CMO hires at S&P 500 companies came from a different industry (data to Jun 2025); 37% in 2022 (Fortune 500).
61% of Fortune 1000 CFO hires in 2024 came from a different industry.

Occupation (function) tenure: +12-20% wages per 5 years; industry tenure matters little once occupation is controlled (Kambourov & Manovskii 2009). For managers, one study finds skills mainly industry-specific: about +23% per 5 years of industry experience (Sullivan 2010). The two disagree.
Moves that keep or add skills recover; skill-distant moves lose more over 15 years (16.5% vs 8.7% for stayers; 22.4% when moving down in skills vs 8.9% up).
